issues.reason: The named obliques apply only when the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither and the rule is to "decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest" — "died from SARS" names a cause, not a whence, so it takes the preposition-named oblique From.

The instruction set is deliberately surface-faithful — the head is the preposition actually used, and merging distinct surface forms into one relation is explicitly downstream normalization — so "from SARS" and "with the virus" taking different licensed encodings (From vs Instrument, the latter correct for the means/substance of infecting) is not a defect.

The text supplies the class word for that referent ("the virus"), and a definite NP inside a seal projects its Member/Name typing atom to top level, so (Member sars virus) is licensed, traceable to the words, and missing — the Name atom was correctly projected while the typing was dropped.

This is the reviewer's own q2 gap, not a defect: nothing inside a seal is asserted at top level and the seal offers no per-conjunct truth-value slot (the same limitation already registered for a negated conjunct inside a sealed complement), so no false or over-asserted atom results from the wrapper's TV.

gaps_confirmed: "N more X" — an additive count relative to a prior running total ("nine more people had died", "160 more were infected"); Cardinality records a plain group size and nothing carries the additive presupposition

no truth value for a conjunct inside a seal — the embedded distribution rules cannot carry their own 0.9 confidence, the structural limitation already registered for a negated conjunct in a sealed complement

a country name used metonymically as the holder of a reported attitude ("China said") — the impersonal-reported-attitude section covers an unstated holder, not a named institution standing for its officials
new_gaps: a two-conjunct clausal complement under one attitude verb ("said [P] and that [Q]") — sealing specifies "several as (And ...)" but not whether coordinated complement clauses nest as an And of Ands or flatten into one And, so the seal's arity is unspecified
repair_summary: Replaced both occurrences of (Source ... sars) with the preposition-named oblique (From ... sars) inside the sealed dying clause (group event and per-member rule alike). Added the projected top-level typing atom (: sars_kind (Member sars virus) (STV 1.0 0.99)) beside the existing Name atom.
notes: The Instrument on "infected with the virus" is correct as it stands (the means/substance test), so it was left alone. Everything else — Experiencer holder for the say attitude, the counted-plural group + Cardinality + group event + per-member rule, and the past perfect taking no Before inside a seal — is per the instruction set.
